human_authorization.scope: One additional round only. Proceed US-010 only after real US-009 acceptance passes. No automatic extra rounds.

limitations: One small synthetic task, one seed and one native outer ask/evaluate/tell step only.
Scores fed back during search are not independent held-out generalization evidence.
No equal-budget baseline or multi-seed comparison; no algorithm-superiority claim.
MetaDE is not integrated into this acceptance.
